title: Ledger Coding Reference — Membership Holdback on Card-on-File Charges, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Entry: membership holdback.** For a patient with an active membership under Linden Memberships, part of a card-on-file charge on the Patient Financial Account is held back for the membership desk. The card-on-file charge is reduced by the held-back percentage of itself:

| Patient's Linden Memberships record | Visit type of the In-Person Appointments record carrying the encounter | Held back from the card-on-file charge |
|---|---|---|
| active membership | Advanced Imaging Appointment or In-Office Procedure Visit | the imaging discount percentage of the patient's membership tier |
| active membership | Specialist Consultation | 10 percent |
| active membership | any other visit type | nothing |
| no active membership | any | nothing |

**Reading the entry.**

- "Active" is the membership status recorded under Linden Memberships on the handling date; the imaging discount percentage is the one set for the tier of that active membership.
- The visit type is the one on the In-Person Appointments record that carries the encounter number of the lines being charged.
- The holdback is a percentage of the charge itself, so the amount charged to the card is the charge less that percentage of it.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A card-on-file charge of 600.00 on a Specialist Consultation for an active member: 10 percent, 60.00, is held back and 540.00 is charged. The same charge on an Advanced Imaging Appointment for a member whose tier's imaging discount percentage is (for illustration) 15 percent: 90.00 is held back and 510.00 is charged. For a patient without an active membership, 600.00 is charged.
